subject: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emma Stone <emma@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination

Team / Emma —

We need to lock the liaison pattern for the upcoming model/API phase that will affect Acme's embed endpoints and a set of legacy chat routes. Goal is to have a single cross-functional liaison who will coordinate: customer notices, exemption intake, canary windows, and the technical migration checklist.

What I need today:
- Confirm owners for each lane (product, comms, legal, sales)
- Agree a preliminary customer-facing timeline we can send to Acme by EOD Monday
- Flag any blockers that require an escalation / exception (e.g., SDK breaking changes, compliance docs)

I've attached an initial communication draft and a rough migration timeline. Please review and call out any unavoidable blockers.

Attachments: comm_plan_v1.pdf, migration_timeline.xlsx, redwood_kickoff_agenda.docx

Thanks — I'll host a 30m sync if helpful.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Program Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emma Stone <emma@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination

On Mon, Nov 8, 2026 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team / Emma —
> 
> We need to lock the liaison pattern for the upcoming model/API phase that will affect Acme's embed endpoints...

Quick notes from comms side:
- We can push a short customer notice (announcement + staggered timeline) by Monday, but it must be cleared by Legal first.
- Proposed customer-facing milestones in migration_timeline.xlsx: notice -> 60d opt-in canary -> 30d mandatory cutover -> 14d final deprecation.
- I recommend a single-sender cadence: product PM (Aditya) for technical details, comms (Lauren) for copy + FAQ, sales (Ben) for account-level exceptions.

I've updated migration_timeline.xlsx with a suggested cadence and included a template for the notice in comm_plan_v1.pdf.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Communications
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emma Stone <emma@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination

Thanks — a couple of product-side clarifications: 
- Which endpoints exactly are in scope? We need a canonical list (embed v1/v1beta, chat-legacy routes) so SDK owners can map breaking changes.
- If Acme needs an exemption, what's the formal intake and SLA for a decision? We should avoid open-ended exceptions that block rollouts.
- Technical blockers: any customer with heavy KV-cache usage or pinned quantized models might require additional runtime support; we'll need to know window sizes for canaries to size capacity.

Proposed owners:
- Product liaison: Aditya Rao (technical, SDK/dep management)
- Exemption intake: Ben Carter (sales) + Rishi Malhotra (policy)

Linking the migration playbook for reviewers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
PM, Serving Platform
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emma Stone <emma@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination

Thanks all — from comms & program standpoint: 
- I can be the customer-facing comms owner (copy + FAQs). We should aim for a one-week internal review window before sending to Acme.
- Proposed outgoing: 
  * Initial notice (short, impact + action required) — send once Legal confirms wording.
  * Detailed migration doc + runbook in Drive (internal + customer versions).
  * A follow-up technical webinar during canary window.

Can we aim for the following immediate next steps?
- Today: finalize owner list and confirm the exact routes in scope (Aditya)
- Tomorrow: Legal to review notice (Rishi looped)
- Mon: Send draft notice to Acme, set a 30m sync for Tues with their eng + our PM/infra leads.

Lauren Bishop
Head, Product Marketing & Comms
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Emma Stone <emma@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination

Thanks — appreciate the proactive coordination. A few asks from Acme: 
- We typically need 90 days for major client-controlled deps; can you confirm if a longer runway is possible for strategic accounts?
- Exemption path: we need to know contact and expected response SLA (we'll be pulling procurement and engineers into the sync).
- Please include any security evidence we can hand to our compliance team (SOC2 / data residency notes).

Happy to join the Tue sync — would prefer 10:30–11:00 PT.

Emma Stone
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp
emma@acme.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-10T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint phase & comms liaison: API/model migration coordination — owners & next steps

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. Consolidating action items and owners so there's a single view for Acme and internal teams: 

Owners (final):
- Customer comms / notice: Lauren Bishop (will finalize copy once Legal clears)
- Technical migration owner & SDK mapping: Aditya Rao
- Exemption intake & decision: Ben Carter (owner), Rishi Malhotra (policy reviewer) — target SLA 5 business days for initial decision
- Program lead & liaison: Soojin Lee (this thread + kickoff sync owner)

Immediate next steps:
1) Aditya to send canonical list of endpoints in-scope by EOD today (migration_timeline.xlsx -> sheet: endpoints).
2) Rishi to surface any legal/policy constraints and confirm what compliance artifacts we can share (SOC2 / data residency) by tomorrow.
3) Lauren to route comm_plan_v1.pdf to Legal and return with edits by EOD Monday.
4) Ben to prepare the exemption intake form and HubSpot intake (HS-4421) template.
5) Schedule: Tues 2026-11-11 10:30–11:00 PT — joint sync with Acme (Invite sent).

Docs / links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123 | HubSpot HS-4421 | DocuSign 0a1b2c
Attachments: comm_plan_v1.pdf, migration_timeline.xlsx, redwood_kickoff_agenda.docx

If there are any blockers to owners or the proposed SLA for exemptions, call them out on this thread. I will hold the kickoff and manage the invite / recording.

— Soojin
